amendment_reason: Run v1 crashed BEFORE producing any predictive result (no fold-0 prediction, no metric). Traceback: FinetunedTabPFNClassifier._evaluate_model -> eval_classifier.predict_proba(X_val) -> TabPFNCUDAOutOfMemoryError: tried to allocate 1519.05 GiB. That allocation is exactly the full 50000 x 509708 x 16-head fp32 attention matrix: the library's inner-validation classifier inherits constructor defaults when the corresponding keys are absent from extra_classifier_kwargs, and the default inference_precision ('auto') resolved to fp32 math-backend SDPA, which materializes the matrix. v1 passed only model_path + categorical_features_indices, omitting the champion's inference_precision='autocast'. Fix = actually pass the champion fold-0 inference params the prereg already promised ('champion fold-0 route params verbatim'). NO decision-rule, seed, context, split, or epoch changes.

delta_from_v1.extra_classifier_kwargs: added inference_precision='autocast' (champion param; bf16 -> flash/mem-efficient SDPA, no materialization), kv_cache_precision='int8' (champion param; no cache is built in the FT estimator's batched mode nor the eval classifier's fit_preprocessors mode, so effect-free, kept for recipe fidelity), auto_scale_n_estimators=False (champion param; pins the frozen 2/2/2 estimator counts against size-based rescaling)
delta_from_v1.unchanged: hypothesis, frozen rule (port_delta >= +5e-5 AND spearman < 0.995 vs route_ref), route view, FIT/EVAL split, seed 1201, epochs 30 + ES patience 8, validation_split_ratio 0.1 (FIT-internal), time_limit 2400s, ctx 50000, estimator counts 2/2/2, activation checkpointing, output_dir=None, checkpoint sha-assertion
delta_from_v1.library_constraint_note: fit_mode is NOT passable through extra_classifier_kwargs (the FT module sets fit_mode='batched' for its own estimator and the inner-validation classifier defaults to 'fit_preprocessors'); the eval path therefore re-runs the forward without a KV cache, which under autocast stays within 16 GB (verified: the champion's own fold-0 predicts run the same architecture forward at the same 559k-token context under autocast)
delta_from_v1.evidence_class: resource/placement repair only; no result existed to bias

hypothesis: Weight-updating the champion's own TabPFN v3.5 checkpoint on FIT via the official Prior-Labs finetuning module (FinetunedTabPFNClassifier, full fine-tuning with inner validation early stopping) extracts task-specific signal that pure in-context learning misses: the fine-tuned model's equal-logit blend with route_ref beats route_ref by >= +5e-5 AUC with Spearman < 0.995 on primary fold-0.
why_distinct: Every prior screen used v3.5 ZERO-SHOT (in-context learning only, no weight updates). This is the only official, documented weight-update path for the champion architecture (audit closed row 33: no LoRA/adapters exist anywhere; full FT is the only weight-update surface). The fine-tuned model starts from the champion checkpoint and adapts to FIT, so it is the single most-plausible remaining de-novo improvement axis: if ICL at 560k rows leaves signal on the table that gradient steps can capture, this finds it.

decision_rule.also_reported: standard screen_metrics table vs champion portfolio (fold-0 AUC 0.961828)

champion checkpoint sha256-asserted and used read-only; output_dir=None
